subject: Passing state of one widget to another.

messages.author: 4f782baffe1b9d1a
messages.subject: Passing state of one widget to another.
parts:
I've got an interface in which I'd like to pass the state of one
VariableSelectorWidget on to another VariableSelectorWidget. The
first one appears on the main screen, where the user selects their
data set and variables. The second one is on a "Plot Options" sub-
screen, and I'd prefer to have the same data set from screen 1 already
selected for screen 2. I tried this:

plotVariableSelector$setModel(variableSelector$getModel())

But it didn't seem to have any effect. Suggestions, anyone?

Thanks!
--Bill

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Passing state of one widget to another.
parts:
hum, setModel worked for me. Does the following solve your issue?

plotFunction <- function(cmd,ActionEvent){
plotEZ$setLocationRelativeTo(plotButton)
pd <- plotVariableSelector$getModel()
vd <- variableSelector$getModel()
if(pd==vd){
plotEZ$run()
}else{
plotEZ$reset()
plotVariableSelector$setModel(variableSelector$getModel())
plotEZ$run()
}
}
